rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making a process or workplace operate automatically with less human labor.

example.english: The factory plans to automate gradually and save a lot of labor.
example.traditional: 間廠打算逐步自動化，慳返好多人工。

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress replacing people or manual labor with machines rather than merely making a process automatic.

example.english: The new system will automate the work, replacing the people who used to do it.
example.traditional: 新系統會用機器代替人手，做埋以前要幾個人做嘅工。
